player_0.content: New plan: I misunderstood the specific vocabulary for the game actions. The prompt explicitly stated I could use "acion", "shness", and "arger", but I repeatedly used standard verbs like "open" and "take" which the game rejected. I should have immediately tried the unique action words provided in the instructions (e.g., > acion, > shness, > arger) instead of guessing common English verbs. Additionally, I failed to read the initial state correctly; I assumed the wardrobe was the target or that items were movable without interaction, but I should have first identified the correct action to interact with the wardrobe using the special verbs to access the "arliced", then used the correct verbs to move the "comper" and "comess" to their specific locations (atent, table, distral).
